reference_sql:
WITH m AS (
  -- one row per product and week in the range
  SELECT w.product_id, w.week_start, w.units,
    AVG(w.units) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY w.week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_4w,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY w.week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS weeks_in_window
  FROM weekly_units w
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = w.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 16
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT product_id, week_start, units, ROUND(avg_4w, 2) AS avg_units_4w
FROM m
WHERE weeks_in_window = 4

WITH m AS (
  -- one row per product and week in the range
  SELECT w.product_id, w.week_start, w.units,
    LAG(w.units, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY w.week_start) AS prev_1,
    LAG(w.units, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY w.week_start) AS prev_2,
    LAG(w.units, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY w.week_start) AS prev_3
  FROM weekly_units w
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = w.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 16
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT product_id, week_start, units, ROUND((units + prev_1 + prev_2 + prev_3) / 4.0, 2) AS avg_units_4w
FROM m
WHERE prev_3 IS NOT NULL

FROM (

    AVG(w.units) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY w.week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_4w,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY w.week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM weekly_units w
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = w.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 16
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
) AS t
WHERE n = 4

solver.query:
SELECT product_id, week_start, units, avg_units_4w FROM (
  SELECT w.product_id, CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) AS week_start, w.units,
         ROUND(AVG(w.units) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS avg_units_4w,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY w.product_id ORDER BY CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM weekly_units w JOIN products p ON p.product_id = w.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 16 AND CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
) WHERE n = 4
